archive.scope: Complete frozen and held-out benchmark archives, each including protocol, source snapshot, exact inputs, records, witnesses and original checksums. These are benchmark evidence, not research campaign checkpoints.

decision: Keep portfolio-frontier-v3 as default; leaf-portfolio-v4 remains an opt-in experiment because both measured workloads regressed.
limitations: Frozen states are first 100 eligible states per v1/v2 trace on a reused development corpus, not independent holdout trees. Every retained state, including trivial and negative cases, is included.
Residual DFS is a complete descending search without memoization or capacity pruning; the microbenchmark does not reproduce full portfolio processing.
Residual timing totals are only tens of milliseconds and fluctuate; no precise universal performance ratio is supported.
Residual negatives concern fixed partial labelings only and have no independently checked UNSAT certificate.

Held-out shapes exclude every isomorphism class from all three earlier benchmark corpora; both routes use the same 40,000-node and one-second attempt allowances. The sample has 48 trees, all with 35 or 75 vertices.
No method was tuned after inspecting these results. Unknown attempts are censored observations, not evidence against gracefulness.
Recorded git commits are pre-edit bases; saved source hashes and included source snapshots identify the measured code.

protocol.evidence: All reconstructed positive full labelings are independently verified. Residual negatives apply only to the fixed partial labeling and are not independently certified UNSAT results. Benchmark archives are not campaign checkpoints.
protocol.frozen: Existing 48-tree development corpus; capture v1 and v2 separately with the new shortcut disabled. Retain first configured number of eligible states per trace, including trivial and failing cases; count all eligible states. No filtering by either completion result. Freeze inputs before timing. Alternate method order. DFS is ordinary complete descending leaf branching without memoization or capacity pruning; cutoffs stay unknown. This microbenchmark does not compare full portfolio runtimes.
protocol.held_out: 48 unique non-caterpillar trees, six per family/order, excluding every class in all three earlier benchmark corpora. Inputs and variants saved before measurement; no tuning after these results. Both portfolios use identical time and node allowances. Unknowns are censored. This is not a comparison with published state of the art.
